Exercise 7. a) ǧayš, army · b) siǧn, prison · c) ḥisāb, account; account · d) rasmī, official · e) maǧlis, council, assembly · f) naṣṣ, text Exercise 8. a) ⁧صَبَاح⁩ : both dark, for the ṣ initial · b) ⁧سَلَام⁩ : clear vowels, no emphasis · c) ⁧مَرِيض⁩ : ī next to ḍ it opens slightly; the next m remains clear (the neighbor can darken it a little) · d) ⁧جَيْش⁩ : clear · e) ⁧ضَرْب⁩ : dark · f) ⁧مِصْر⁩ : the i opens and backs close to ṣ. Exercise 9. a) ⁧حِسَاب رَسْمِيّ⁩ ḥisāb rasmī, official account · ⁧مَجْلِس⁩ maǧlis, advice · ⁧سِجْن⁩ siǧn, prison · ⁧صَبَاح⁩ ṣabāḥMorning. b) Plausible: suǧina ṣaḥafiyyun A journalist has been imprisoned and saǧnu ṣaḥafiyyin The imprisonment of a journalist. The reported fact doesn't change: in English you can make the journalist imprisoned. Reading siǧnu ṣaḥafiyyin The prison of a journalist is grammatically possible but unlikely in a title. Here ambiguity does not alter the content; with ⁧دين⁩ ( L0-03) Yes, it is: in a relationship only the ambiguity that changes the sense is indicated.
